http_to_https.name: Convert HTTP to HTTPS
http_to_https.description: Change HTTP URLs to HTTPS for secure downloads

add_checksum_verification.name: Add Checksum Verification
add_checksum_verification.description: Add SHA256 checksum verification for downloaded files
examples: Add SHA256 verification after curl downloads

combine_apk_commands.name: Combine APK Commands
combine_apk_commands.description: Combine apk update and apk add into single RUN command
combine_apk_commands.template: RUN apk update && apk add --no-cache <packages> && rm -rf /var/cache/apk/*
examples:
RUN apk update
RUN apk add curl → RUN apk update && apk add --no-cache curl

add_non_root_user.name: Add Non-Root User
add_non_root_user.description: Add non-root user and switch to it
add_non_root_user.template:
RUN addgroup -g 1000 appuser && adduser -D -u 1000 -G appuser appuser
USER appuser
examples: Add USER directive after installing packages

update_base_image.name: Update Base Image
update_base_image.description: Update to latest stable base image version

conditions.when: base image is EOL or outdated

migrate_dep_to_go_modules.name: Migrate from dep to Go Modules
migrate_dep_to_go_modules.template:
COPY go.mod go.sum ./
RUN go mod download
COPY . .
RUN go build
examples: Remove dep ensure, use go mod download

fix_goarch_mismatch.name: Fix GOARCH Mismatch
fix_goarch_mismatch.description: Fix architecture mismatch between Go binary and downloaded binaries

replace_maintainer.name: Replace MAINTAINER with LABEL
replace_maintainer.description: Replace deprecated MAINTAINER with LABEL maintainer
